parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility, document, custody or care rule is documented, and the only enforcement is a single 2015 private-home arrest with no later case documented; absence of later evidence is not safety. The same-sex criminalisation—up to 8 years plus 100 lashes—is secondary for a trans visitor, but it is not shown to be a dead letter, official posture is hostile, recommendations were rejected, and there is no anti-discrimination recourse. UN reporting that people perceived as transgender face hate crimes, pervasive LGBTQ stigma, and lack of any documented acceptance of trans people as a distinct group indicate societal hostility with thin remedy. Resort tolerance is travel-guidance, not a legal exemption, and classification of a trans visitor under the sex-based provisions is unresolved. This is elevated risk, above unremedied universal-exposure regimes but well below acceptance-with-protections jurisdictions.
